payload.summary: Dictionary sources still missing a publication date: 9 after PR #3067 (row opened at 21)
payload.detail: 17 dictionary sources now have dates; only 9 sources still lack dates (PR #3067). PRIOR DETAIL (restored 2026-10-09, an earlier update replaced it wholesale): UPDATE 2026-09-26 (owner decisions relayed via the coordinator, 'yes to all five'; offline, no provider access; PR #3067): Owner approved recording a publisher's 'last updated' stamp as its own date (lastUpdatedDate, dateModel last_updated), never as a publication or review date. Five more sources admitted as unverified candidates on their own stamps: AIHW-NASS-2026, AIHW-SUICIDE-2026, WA-MHAS, WA-MHERL, WA-OCP-MHA. Counts now 26 admitted, 32 held. RCH-MSE-2024 stays held (rch.org.au not governed; jurisdiction not in register form). Moved documents: WA-MHC-FORM-LIST found at a new MHC address (undated), health-mental-rights found as the November 2012 statement; nsw-mse-handbook is no longer hosted and is recommended for retirement. PRIOR DETAIL: UPDATE 2026-09-26 (owner-approved page reads from the cloud session, no provider access): All 21 date-needing sources plus the two held for unreadable pages were read. Three now have a stated date and are admitted as unverified candidates: NSW-ACI-SCI ('Publication date 2021-08-30', 'Version: 1'), nsw-mental-assessment ('Published: December 2023') and APA-BIPOLAR (physician review 'April 2024', continuously updated). Held 40 -> 37. Four now have a date but stay held on GOVERNED_SOURCE_HOSTS, which the owner declined to widen: AADPA-ADHD (First Edition, released October 2022), ACSQHC-MED-2024 (Publication Year 2024), WA-HSP-ACRONYMS-2026 (published September 2023), WA-AHD-2026 (last reviewed 01-08-2022). WA-PSOLIS-HSS gives only an update stamp. Three URLs no longer serve the document (WA-MHC-FORM-LIST-2022, health-mental-rights, nsw-mse-handbook). WA-ABORIGINAL-TITLES-2026 states two conflicting 'as at' dates. AMHOCN, Columbia, DIVA, the three NACCHO pages, ASSIST Plus and COPE state no visible date (metadata timestamps were not used). Per-source findings are in dictionary-source-dispositions.json. NEXT: owner decisions on host policy and an update-date event; find current URLs for the three moved documents. PRIOR DETAIL: RECHECKED 2026-09-25: no dates added. The cloud session's network egress refuses every publisher host (wa.gov.au, mhc.wa.gov.au, aihw.gov.au, ruah.org.au, youthfocus.com.au, passages.org.au, healthdirect.gov.au and others all returned connect_rejected on 2026-09-25), and the sources skill forbids taking a publisher, date or contact detail from anywhere but the publisher's own page, so this cannot be done from a cloud session. TO UNBLOCK: run it from an unrestricted network, for example a Remote Control session on the owner's PC, or have the owner approve each page fetch. Never infer a date from a search summary. PRIOR DETAIL: REVIEW 2026-09-25 (offline audit of current main; no provider access): Dispositions now show 40 held and 18 admitted (row said 41 held). The 'publisher registered, date still required' blocker applies to 12 sources, not 17. The AIHW premise is stale: PR #2819 (8cdadc445) read the AIHW pages; AIHW-OAT-2026 is admitted, and AOD, NASS and SUICIDE are held because the publisher gives only an update stamp or undated page, not because of a 403. The count of 21 needing a date is correct. PRIOR DETAIL: After the 2026-09-16 register work, 41 of the 58 dictionary-handover sources remain held and the binding constraint is now a date rather than governance. None of the 41 carries a publication or review date in the handover. Seventeen have a publisher that is now registered and need only a date read from the publisher's own page. Four AIHW pages (alcohol and other drug treatment glossary, suicide and self-harm monitoring glossary, ambulance attendances, opioid agonist therapy in the prisons report) returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch; AIHW is registered and ledger-eligible, so a release date is the only thing missing for all four. A WA Health PDF and the national recovery framework also need a browser read. Per-source blockers and next actions are in src/data/dictionary-source-dispositions.json.
